verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמוֹר לִבְנֵי־ קֹֽרַח׃ גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ הַר־
verses.transliteration: šîr miz·mō·wr liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ gā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ū·mə·hul·lāl bə·‘îr ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū qā·ḏə·šōw har-
verses.literal: A song A Psalm of the sons of Korah Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised in the city of our God His holy mountain

verses.original: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל־ הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן הַר־ צִ֭יּוֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת רָֽב׃ מֶ֣לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: yə·p̄êh nō·wp̄ mə·śō·wś kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ yar·kə·ṯê ṣā·p̄ō·wn har- ṣî·yō·wn qir·yaṯ rāḇ me·leḵ
verses.literal: Beautiful in loftiness the joy of all the earth like the peaks of Zaphon [is] Mount Zion the city of the great King
God is in her citadels He has shown Himself to be a fortress

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.literal: For behold the kings assembled they all advanced together

verses.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃ נִבְהֲל֥וּ
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh rā·’ū kên tā·mā·hū neḥ·pā·zū niḇ·hă·lū
verses.literal: They saw and were astounded they fled in terror
Trembling seized them there anguish like a woman in labor
With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ׀ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־ יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד־ עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer šā·ma‘·nū kên rā·’î·nū bə·‘îr- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·‘îr ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·ḵō·wn·ne·hā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām se·lāh
verses.literal: As we have heard so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts in the city of our God God will establish her forever . . . Selah
Within Your temple O God we contemplate Your loving devotion

verses.original: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־ קַצְוֵי־ אֶ֑רֶץ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ מָלְאָ֥ה צֶ֝֗דֶק
verses.transliteration: kə·šim·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm kên tə·hil·lā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- qaṣ·wê- ’e·reṣ yə·mî·ne·ḵā mā·lə·’āh ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: Your name O God . . . like Your praise reaches to the ends of the earth Your right hand is full of righteousness

verses.original: הַר־ צִיּ֗וֹן יִשְׂמַ֤ח׀ בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה תָּ֭גֵלְנָה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: har- ṣî·yō·wn yiś·maḥ bə·nō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh tā·ḡê·lə·nāh lə·ma·‘an miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā
verses.literal: Mount Zion is glad the daughters of Judah rejoice on account of Your judgments
March around Zion encircle her count her towers

verses.original: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם׀ לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ אַחֲרֽוֹן׃ לְד֣וֹר
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯū lib·bə·ḵem lə·ḥê·lāh pas·sə·ḡū ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā lə·ma·‘an tə·sap·pə·rū ’a·ḥă·rō·wn lə·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: consider . . . her ramparts tour her citadels that you may tell the next generation

verses.original: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־ מֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kî zeh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ hū yə·na·hă·ḡê·nū ‘al- mūṯ
verses.literal: For this God [is] our God forever and ever He will be our guide even till death
